claims.source_quote_ar: وسط الواو بين النعوت لتوكيد ربطها بالمنعوت.
claims.claim_ar: وجود الواو الواصلة بين الفعلين «هاجروا» و«جاهدوا» يعمل كوسيلة (وسط الواو) لتوكيد ربط الفعلين بمنعوت الخبر (الذين)، فيجعل الأعمال متصلة متكافلة في أثرها ودورها في الاستحقاق.
claims.claim_en: The connective waw between the verbs 'hajarū' and 'jahadū' functions as the 'middle waw' (wāw in the middle of epithets), reinforcing the link of these actions to the described subject and making the deeds read as a unified set.
claims.rhetorical_effect: Emphasizes the unity and cumulative value of migration and striving as jointly qualifying the believers who hope for God's mercy.

claims.source_quote_ar: الَّذِينَ يُؤْمِنُونَ إما موصول بالمتقين على أنه صفة مجرورة، أو مدح منصوب، أو مرفوع بتقدير
claims.claim_ar: المبتدأ «الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا» قابل لأن يُقرأ موصولًا أو مقتطعًا؛ هذه القابلية في التوقيف والفصل تمنح العبارة قدرة بلاغية على التركيز أو التمهيد، فتارة تُعطى الصفة وقيمة المدح مباشرة وتارة تُؤخر للدلالة أو للتجزئة.
claims.claim_en: The relative clause 'alladhīna āmanū' can be read as connected or detached; this flexibility in stopping and pausing provides a rhetorical option to either foreground the attribute as a continuous description or to detach it for emphatic, punctuated praise.
claims.needs_review_reason: Mapping the discussion of «الَّذِينَ يُؤْمِنُونَ» in the source (present-tense phrasing) to the past-tense form in the verse requires reviewer confirmation; the rhetorical generalization is inferred from the source.
claims.rhetorical_effect: Provides pause/continuity options that affect emphasis: either a flowing description of the faithful or a clipped, emphatic naming of the group.

claims.claim_ar: استعمال إشارة إخبارية مثل «أُولَئِكَ» في صدر الخبر يعمل كأسلوب بلاغي لتعيين المجموعة المذكورة والتفرقة بينها وبين غيرها، أي إنه أسلوب بلاغي لتحديد المقصود وتمييزه.
claims.claim_en: The demonstrative 'ulā'ika (those) in the predicate acts as a rhetorical, stylistic device to single out and distinguish the described group from others; it marks specification and contrast.
claims.needs_review_reason: Source example uses phrasing («ثُمَّ أَنْتُمْ هؤُلاءِ») to illustrate demonstrative pointing in context; applying it to this verse is plausible but inferential — reviewer should confirm categorization as 'asloob_hakim'.
claims.rhetorical_effect: Creates a clear demarcation between those described (believers, emigrants, fighters) and others, enhancing the moral/ethical delineation.

warnings: Provided source chunks are primarily from Zamakhshari and a i'rab note; the developer instruction named other classical rhetoricians (al-Jurjani, al-Sakkaki, al-Baqillani, al-Suyuti, tafsir balagha) but such chunks were not included — some rhetorical mappings are therefore inferred from available material and should be reviewed against the intended classical sources.

Some source quotations use present-tense or slightly different lexical forms (e.g., «الَّذِينَ يُؤْمِنُونَ») while the verse uses other forms (e.g., «آمَنُوا»); these were used as supporting evidence but require reviewer confirmation for direct applicability.
No explicit source substrings were found for certain potential devices (e.g., pairing of divine names «غفور رحيم» as a badi device). Such devices were not asserted to avoid unsupported claims.
